name: hedera-x402-mcp-template
description: A Hedera testnet template demonstrating an x402-paid MCP tool using HashPack, native HBAR, and a self-hosted Hedera facilitator.

steps.text: Hedera testnet demo: a fixed-price x402-protected MCP tool, HashPack HBAR payment, self-hosted facilitator, plus the FileRegistry/private-file marketplace.

steps.label: Copy environment examples
steps.text: Copy .env.example to .env and packages/nextjs/.env.example to packages/nextjs/.env.

steps.label: Configure testnet accounts and app settings
steps.text: Set the funded ECDSA facilitator account/key in root .env. Set the WalletConnect project ID and matching X402_MCP_PAY_TO / NEXT_PUBLIC_X402_MCP_PAY_TO values in packages/nextjs/.env. Use Hedera testnet and fund the facilitator and buyer accounts.
Fund the generated deployer account, then run `yarn hardhat:deploy --network hederaTestnet` to deploy FileRegistry.

Open /mcp-test, connect HashPack, and follow the page's explicit approval prompt for the fixed 0.01 HBAR testnet MCP demo. See README.md and RUNBOOK.md for the file marketplace and verification details.
